name: A dark air under the exposed passages

surface.note: One bed at a time, under the exposed passages (a breakdown with no fast drums), lower under an intro and an outro, absent in every full passage. A span is laid in events of eight bars that overlap by the bed's own fades, so a seek resumes the same surface on the next one; its level and its brightness follow one slow arc over the span, darker and lower at its ends.

provenance.knowledge: authored: the research manual's listening hypotheses for this checkpoint (its §3, §5 and §6), written as rows so the weights are his to move; no record's arrangement copied
provenance.note: The manual's N1 (dark air) and N4 (one slow arc a section), on the vinyl topology's dark row (packages/engine/sounds/noise/airBed.json).
